message: Missive is a shared-inbox email tool that agency staff can use to assign and discuss client emails as a team. Verified product facts support this first-email scope: Start Missive's 30-day free trial without a credit card and, inside it, turn a client email into a task and mention a teammate to hand off drafting or processing it — the single next step the email asks for. Draft this documented use. Treat recipient circumstances as unconfirmed.
